output.rationale: The core problem is a stalled mortgage application: underwriting keeps re-requesting documents, the rate lock expires 10/4 and closing is 10/9, so mortgage applications (Mortgage Servicing) owns it and it is time-sensitive. The unresponsive loan officer is a service-quality and staff-responsiveness issue that could go to Branch & Contact Center as secondary. It is closely tied to the mortgage process, though, so the secondary is debatable.
